newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

PARANAGUA: Vessels: Elmar Kivistik loading 38,000 tonnes soybeans/meal. Orestius Ermig loading 25,000 tonnes soymeal. Mariner A loading 49,000 tonnes soymeal. Modi loading 38,000 tonnes soymeal/corn. Seabone loading 50,000 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, 11 vessels to load soymeal, nine to load soybeans and three for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal).
Road: 3,528 trucks carrying soybeans arrived between April 11 and 13, 642 trucks with soymeal and 143 with vegetable oils, including soyoil.
Vessels: At the Cargill private terminal, Sea Challenger loading 36,000 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock were three vessels to load soybeans, one to load soymeal.
Road: 203 trucks unloaded 5,322 tonnes soybeans between April 11 and 13 and five trucks unloaded 140 tonnes soymeal.
NOTE: Stevedores continued to occupy two vessels at the private terminal of steel firm Cosipa. Five vessels were waiting to dock at the terminal.
